description.value:
The following augmentations are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one, and you may install an augmentation the same moment you meet its prerequisites.

  • Active Camouflage Core (requires 13th level): as an action, this augmentation lets you cast infiltrate on yourself, using Intelligence as your techcasting ability and requiring no concentration.
  • Anti-Dazzle Ocular Implant (replaces your eyes): you're immune to the blinded condition and can enable or disable your sight at will; a built-in holorecorder also grants perfect recall of anything you've seen in the last 7 days.
  • Auto-Defibrillator (requires 5th level and Hardy Torso Prosthesis): your Hardy Torso Prosthesis's Constitution score increases by 2, and if damage would drop you to 0 hit points without killing you outright, you may instead drop to 1. Usable once per long rest.
  • Brawny Arm Prosthesis (replaces an arm): an ability check, attack roll, or save using Strength made with only this arm treats your Strength score as 15; made using more than just this arm, you use the average of the arm's score and your own. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Celerity Leg Prosthesis (replaces both legs): for determining your AC and save bonus from Dexterity, your Dexterity score is treated as 15 (no effect if it's already higher), and you may substitute this score for your own on ability checks or attack rolls that use your legs.
  • Detachable Eye (replaces an eye): as an action you can remove or reattach it; detached, it sprouts eight tiny legs and has a speed of 15 feet, AC 10, and 1 hit point, and if destroyed can't be used again until a long rest. As an action on your turns you can move it up to its speed within 30 feet of you, and you can see through both eyes at once or use your action to see through only one. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Detachable Hand (replaces a hand): as an action you can detach or reattach it; detached, it has a speed of 15 feet, AC 10, and 1 hit point, and if destroyed can't be used again until a long rest. As an action on each of your turns you can direct it within 30 feet to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item, or pour out a container's contents, moving up to its speed each time. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Fadecasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): while using your body as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Strength or Constitution save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Hardy Torso Prosthesis (replaces your torso): your Constitution score becomes 13, and you have advantage on saves against poison.
  • Harpoon Hand (replaces a hand): it can transform into a harpoon, making a ranged attack (range 30/60) against a surface, object, or creature, dealing 1d6 kinetic damage on a hit. A struck creature is impaled and can spend its action making a Strength check to remove it; while lodged, a 60-foot cable connects you. As a bonus action you can reel it in — pulling yourself to the target if it's larger than you, or pulling the target to you if it's your size or smaller — or release the cable with no action. After use, your hand must be recovered and reinserted as an action before it can be used again. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Integrated Subdermal Armor (requires 5th level): when you aren't wearing armor, your AC becomes 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.
  • Iridonian Grav-lev Hand (replaces a hand): its unarmed strikes deal 1d4 ion damage, your carrying and push/drag/lift capacity doubles, and your unarmed strikes deal double damage to energy-based structures. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Magnetic Forearm Enhancement (replaces a forearm): unarmed strikes made with this hand gain the reach property. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Mighty Prowess Enabler (requires 5th level and Brawny Arm Prosthesis): the arm's Strength score increases by 2, and you're considered proficient with any weapon wielded in it; if a weapon needs two hands and you lack proficiency otherwise, you add only half your proficiency bonus unless wielding it with two such arms. You can take this modification multiple times, but only once per arm.
  • Nighthawk Ocular Implant (replaces your eyes): as a bonus action you activate or deactivate it, gaining darkvision to 120 feet while active.
  • Powered Harpoon Hand (requires 9th level and Harpoon Hand): while your harpoon hand is deployed, a touch-range tech power you cast can be delivered through it as though it had cast it.
  • Rendcasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): while using your body as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Dexterity or Intelligence save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Skills Enhancement Package (requires 13th level): when making an ability check with a skill you're proficient in, you may roll a d4 and add the result to the total.
  • Sound Dampeners (replaces your ears): you're immune to the deafened condition and can enable or disable your hearing at will; a personal translator lets you understand up to 15 languages (though not speak them), swappable while interfaced with a protocol droid or suitable computer.
  • Surveillance Implant (replaces your face): a headcomm with a scrambler automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient.
  • Survival and Surveillance Implant (requires 9th level; replaces your eyes and face): as a bonus action you activate one of the following modes, deactivating any other: Communications Mode grants a scrambled headcomm that auto-encodes messages, and immunity to deafened while active; Interceptor Mode provides a jamming and electronic-warfare suite with a comm jammer, holotrace device, and pocket scrambler; Respirator Mode grants a basic respirator giving advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.
  • Swift Gait Attuner (requires 5th level and Celerity Leg Prosthesis): the leg's Dexterity score increases by 2, and you gain proficiency in Dexterity saves.
  • Vector Amplifier (requires 5th level): while using your body as a tech focus, +1 to melee tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Vector Rangefinder (requires 5th level): while using your body as a tech focus, +1 to ranged tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Voice Synthesizer (requires 5th level; replaces your throat): you can synthesize and perfectly mimic any voice heard in the last month, and translate speech between up to 5 languages (swappable while interfaced with a protocol droid or suitable computer); you also add your Intelligence modifier to Charisma (Deception) checks made to lie to another creature.
  • Weapon Integration (replaces a forearm): you can build a single weapon of 8 pounds or less into it; a bonus action hides or reveals the weapon, which can only be used while revealed, has the hidden property while hidden, and the fixed property while revealed. You can take this modification multiple times.
  • Withercasting Inhibitor (requires 5th level): while using your body as a tech focus, +1 to the tech save DC of powers you cast that require a Wisdom or Charisma save, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
